images.title: Moon & Moss
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished art-direction and COLOR PALETTE exploration board for the original Scoundrel dungeon card game. Landscape 3:2 board.
Primary request: A SIMPLE, restrained fantasy card design direction inspired by Legends of Runeterra's expressive painted character art, but greatly simplified. Original characters, no game logos or existing characters. Make the COLOR RELATIONSHIPS easy to judge.
Layout: warm ivory paper background. Small elegant header "01 / MOON & MOSS". Below, four equal large upright card mockups in one horizontal row, ordered SPADES, CLUBS, DIAMONDS, HEARTS. Each card has one illustration taking almost all its area, an extremely thin dark frame and a tiny unornamented suit symbol in its top left; NO stats or rules. Under each card, its category label and a generous horizontal strip of THREE solid color swatches (shadow / main / light) with the MAIN hex code clearly typeset beneath.
SPADES: label "BATFOLK". One original small bat-eared dusk-violet humanoid scout in a broad indigo cloak, pale angular face, two big ears, holding one short spear, simple energetic three-quarter pose. Calm pale lavender background with one broad dark arch silhouette. Main #7C6AB5, shadow #302C47, light #C9C0E4.
CLUBS: label "FROGFOLK". One original stout moss-jade frog warrior with large friendly eyes and a simple reed spear, single cream neck scarf, large rounded silhouette. Calm light sage background with one broad lily pad shape. Main #43866D, shadow #233D35, light #BCD5AE.
DIAMONDS: label "MOONSTEEL". One large simple pale icy-blue steel sword leaning diagonally across calm dark blue slate, broad clearly painted blade, plain leather handle. Main #7CB8D0, shadow #293B4B, light #D6EAF0.
HEARTS: label "RED POTIONS". One squat round clear glass healing potion with saturated ruby-red liquid, large cork and one cream highlight, against calm muted burgundy. Main #D65353, shadow #592D38, light #F4B8A5. Liquid MUST be RED.
Style: charming mature painterly fantasy, confident large gouache brush shapes, clear strong facial expressions, dramatic readable light, simplified anatomy and materials, soft lost edges. Each illustration about 70% dominant color family, 20% neutral, 10% light. One subject, one prop, one broad background shape. Readable at thumbnail size. Flat areas deliberately left empty. Keep detail only on face or blade edge; overall much less detail than a typical collectible card.
Avoid: photorealism, skin pores, individual fur strands, scale texture, excessive cloth folds, sparks, particles, dense plants, detailed scenery, baroque gold frames, filigree, ornate armor, decorative borders, floating debris, large lore text, noisy canvas grain, harsh plastic vector icons. Carefully typeset exact labels and hex values. The board is an attractive visual comparison, not a game screen.
